integrity: Proof uses explicit Gaussian calculation, pathwise injection, and Jensen; independent audit not performed. Checker runs finite symbolic and numerical cases only.
scientific_limitations: Finite sixth spectral moment. Bandlimited equality classification only for mesh not exceeding pi/Omega; no extension to rough or nonstationary processes. Prior exact orthant formula and first-order rate are not new.
title: Sharp spectral mesh loss and equality rigidity for stationary Gaussian peak counts
